statement.note_ascii: NEW DERIVATION / PROPOSAL -- not yet in Toledo. Common rules C1-C7 are REUSE (C1 source interval, worst first: PROP-FLOOD-06 v6.1 multi_model_scenarios + A2/M.12-14 / Z/M.12-17; C2 three-state: PROP-FLOOD-10a cl = D/M.71-76 renamed, four states ROBUST/AT_THRESHOLD/POSSIBLE/BELOW, lo = theta < hi is POSSIBLE; C4 refinement: PROP-FLOOD-10a nested box -- a determinate parent is inherited, never flipped; non-nested partitions such as the 50 Bangkok districts vs the 38 BMA sub-polders are REFUSED NOT_NESTED for strict refinement, cross-partition readout only; opposite determinate states on declared-nested units are kept as a contradiction row; C6 claim ceilings: weld/E.07, EQ-002/M.01, forecast-only cap L1 of 06; C7 upward counts in [certain, certain + unresolved]: D/M.79-80). The three deltas: 10.1 compute gate (children only under ROBUST/AT_THRESHOLD/POSSIBLE, or under a parent REFUSED for any reason when the child has its own inputs (stated once, identical in MD/JSON/Coq); BELOW stops; a child never inherits a verdict or a refusal; bounded by a declared N_cells, termination by EQ-001/C.18); 10.2 single-source guard (one source with undeclared spread is never ROBUST/BELOW -- a degenerate interval is otherwise always determinate); 10.3 verification ledger (5 cells; UNRESOLVED never counted as CORRECT_NEG; every row in exactly one cell; CORRECT_NEG never exceeds resolved NO_EVENT rows; strict firing implies worst-first firing (for every zoom readout, any declared spread); lead in integer ticks, left-censored onset => upper bound; skill claim refused below a declared N_min, and refused when N_min is undeclared). Levels 0-3 are instances. Inbound stacked debt is PROP-FLOOD-09 D_in, reported beside the rain state. Statements are area-generic; the MVP test scope is Bangkok + Sammakorn only (founder ruling), everything else next version. v2 (after independent review): Level-1 FULL is cl([S_lo, S_hi]; S_safe) -- it can be BELOW -- with the exceedance E_b reported as a magnitude beside it (the v1 cl(E_b; 0) could never be BELOW, so it always fired worst-first and always descended); Level-2 arrival bound is REFUSED TAU_UNDECLARED if any edge on any declared path lacks a delay (dropping a path would silently treat it as never arriving -- a non-readout, and the undeclared path may be the fastest); each evaluated child carries the 10a strict-refinement check, and a passed check with unflagged readouts keeps the parent's determinate side (checked_child_keeps_parent_side); sources are named and a repeated name is REFUSED DUPLICATE_SOURCE; refused readouts carry no bounds (no placeholder value); Level-3 reversed endpoints are BOUND_ORDER.

definitions.Theta: unified rain ladder mm/24h {35.1 (TMD-HII map yellow lower edge), 65.1 (orange), 80 (BMA design capacity, strictest for BMA units), 125.1 (red), 250.1 (purple)} -- boundary data copied from the downstream crosswalk's unified_ladder, tags as recorded there (VERIFIED-transcription / VERIFIED / RELAYED)
definitions.horizon: h := start(W) - t_issue, integer days or hours rounded down; the model's own hindcast of W (h<=0) is not a forecast and is never scored as one
definitions.truth_O: three-state observed readout EVENT / NO_EVENT / UNRESOLVED; for Bangkok districts the downstream event ledger rule (>=3 road stations >=10 cm within a 6 h chain, INSTINCT); a district with fewer than 3 road stations can never fire the rule and is UNRESOLVED, not NO_EVENT
definitions.fires: strict := state = ROBUST; worst-first := not REFUSED and hi >= theta, hi taken from the readout's bounds (a refused readout has no bounds); for >= 2 sources this equals ROBUST, AT_THRESHOLD or POSSIBLE; under the single-source guard hi is the raw value
definitions.N_min: OPEN -- downstream proposes 10 independent events (founder to confirm); undeclared => skill claim REFUSED FEW_EVENTS
definitions.epsilon_src: OPEN per source class (single model, single gauge)
definitions.N_cells: OPEN -- declared ceiling on zoom cells per window
definitions.inbound_stacked_debt: Founder ruling (verbatim): 'โฟกัสที่ กทม. เหมือนเดิม แต่การปล่อยน้ำพวกนี้ ถ้ามันเชื่อมกับลุ่มน้ำ กทม. ควรเป็นหนี้ซ้อนด้วย'. No new object: Delta1 (PROP-FLOOD-09 candidate) booking of one edge value in two node ledgers with a declared integer delay. D_in(b; k_now, H) := sum over edges e=(s->b) of Q_e(k)*tau for released/measured k <= k_now whose arrival k+d_e lies in (k_now, k_now+H]; enters PROP-FLOOD-03 Q_in and PROP-FLOOD-06 Q_in,up/tau_up, reported beside the rain term. d_e declared/measured only, else REFUSED TAU_UNDECLARED. Effects kept separate: (a) river reach raising Chao Phraya stage at the outfalls (03 gate-closed branch, 06 derating g_U; three-state against the BMA +2.00 m MSL line on the MSL datum only); (b) east field water outside the King's dyke pulled west via Saen Saep/Prawet (no feed: REFUSED INPUT_ABSENT). Bangkok-linked sources: C.13 release, C.2/C.29/Sam Khok/Bang Sai discharge, Pasak (Rama VI), Bhumibol/Sirikit, east field water. Excluded as NOT linked (INSTINCT): Mae Klong releases (drain to the Gulf at Samut Songkhram); a link would need a declared Tha Chin/Damnoen Saduak transfer with measured discharge or a lagged rise at west-Bangkok gauges.
definitions.state: ROBUST (Sp: theta < lo) | AT_THRESHOLD (Sz: lo = hi = theta) | POSSIBLE (Sbot: lo <= theta <= hi, lo <> hi) | BELOW (Sm: hi < theta) | REFUSED(reason)
definitions.D_design(U,24): the owner-declared 24 h design depth of PROP-FLOOD-08 (Bangkok 80 mm, VERIFIED downstream); a level-1 PARTIAL readout on any other window uses that window's own declared depth or is REFUSED DESIGN_DEPTH_UNDECLARED
definitions.sources: named pairs (name, value); |M_u| := number of distinct names; a repeated name is REFUSED DUPLICATE_SOURCE, so two copies of one reading never count as two sources (review A11); v2.1: ladder children (zoom_child, evaluate_children) take named sources and go through zoom_state, so the guard applies at every level (review R2-A11)
definitions.compute_gate_C5: evaluate a child iff the parent is ROBUST, AT_THRESHOLD or POSSIBLE, or the parent is REFUSED for ANY reason and the child has its own inputs; BELOW stops (review A3: one statement, identical in MD, JSON and Coq descend)
definitions.level1_full: state := cl([S_lo, S_hi]; S_safe) (ROBUST iff S_safe < S_lo iff certain excess; BELOW iff S_hi < S_safe); E_b in [max(0, S_lo - S_safe), max(0, S_hi - S_safe)] reported as the size of the excess; REFUSED SAFE_STORAGE_UNDECLARED / NEGATIVE_STORAGE / BOUND_ORDER
definitions.level2_arrival: t_arr(v) >= min over ALL declared paths of the summed declared integer delays; REFUSED TAU_UNDECLARED if any edge of any declared path has no declared/measured delay; no declared path -> REFUSED MISSING_INPUT
definitions.level0_rungs: rung0_strict := max{j : S0_j = ROBUST}; rung0_wf := max{j : not refused and hi >= theta_j} (review B1)

monotonicity: Machine-checked: hi (worst) bounds every source and is attained (08 worst_*), lo likewise (best_bounds_every_source); nested child never flips a determinate parent (10a nested_no_flip; in the ladder checked_child_keeps_parent_side); level-3 depth interval encloses the true depth (point_depth_enclosure); level-1 FULL box endpoints (10a wb_step_enclosure). NOT machine-checked (stated only): 'S0 moves up the ladder when a source value rises', 'adding a source never flips Sp<->Sm', and 't_arr lower bound non-increasing when an edge delay decreases' (review A15).
honest_caveats: The 38 BMA sub-polders and the 50 districts are crossing partitions, not a hierarchy: strict refinement between them is REFUSED NOT_NESTED.
Every BMA canal station datum is OPEN downstream; level 3 is REFUSED everywhere today (DATUM_UNDECLARED / Z_MISSING).
No pressure series is archived; the pressure promoter is a candidate only (not part of this object).
The replays available (Bangkok, one meteorological event plus two older groups) exercise the ledger; they calibrate nothing.
The AT_THRESHOLD state is new relative to the draft's three labels: it is classify's Sz and arises only for a degenerate interval exactly at theta; it fires under worst-first, not under strict.
falsifier: (1) Strict L0/L1 ROBUST repeatedly with NO_EVENT truth, or BELOW repeatedly with EVENT truth, across replayed independent events for a unit class, falsifies that ladder edge for the class. (2) A determinate child opposite to a nested determinate parent without an input error falsifies the nesting declaration. (3) An observed arrival earlier than the min-plus lower bound falsifies a declared d_e. For (3) the candidate causes are: a wrong declared d_e, or an undeclared faster path (an edge missing from the declared graph).
